newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama's INTEL sale to boost line installation.
newsitem.headline: Panama's INTEL sale to boost line installation.

text.p: The sale of a minority stake in Panamanian state telephone company INTEL should see installed lines more than double over the next five years, a top government official said Monday.

Line installations should pick up within three months of Tuesday's sale and the total number of lines should increase to 800,000 from 330,000 over five years, said Rigoberto Munoz Diaz, INTEL executive vice president of development.
The winner of Tuesday's auction -- either GTE Corp or Cable and Wireless Plc -- will have to invest about $500 million over five years.
"That's not in the concession contract, but (those are) government estimates on the number of lines we'll need and how much the company would need to spend," Munoz said.
Independent estimates put INTEL's value at $2 billion, although government officials have not given estimates of its value.
